{{Top|leg}}
A '''mass spectral record''' was a target profile generated by [[Golog-Bertum]]'s [[Apex Incisor Missile]]. During operation of the [[Missile/Legends|missile]], the user would point the weapon's nose at the target and depress a stud to take a mass spectral record of the object to be targeted. The mass spectral record of a target included such information as its [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] exhaust signature and its [[shift shield]] output.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
